entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that his clients also need to be granted same relief as has been accorded to the litigants in the cognate writ petition in the absence of any derogatory factors.

Learned Senior Panel Counsel appearing for the Respondents does not much dispute this submission and agrees that the Petitioner be given liberty to approach the Hon'ble Justice K.N.Keshavanarayana Committee for redressal of his grievance, in accordance with law.
Ordered accordingly & Writ Petition is disposed off, all contentions having been kept open.
If the parties are in the occupation of the subject site/s shall not be disturbed till after and subject to the outcome of decision of Hon'ble Justice K.N.Keshavanarayana Committee.
No costs.
